records.title: Groomed Gent parent brand
records.content: Groomed Gent Co. is the parent brand and umbrella identity for the current working company map.

records.title: Physical Legacy Sanctum concept
records.content: A future physical Legacy Sanctum combining grooming, wellness, recovery, community, and hospitality is a long-range exploratory concept, not a signed lease, fixed service menu, or committed rollout.

records.title: Legacy Sanctum naming remains unresolved
records.content: Legacy Sanctum has referred to a supplement/performance line, a member app, and a physical destination. The final product architecture is unresolved and must not be silently inferred.

records.title: Gent Logistics business model
records.content: Gent Logistics is being built as a premium local and regional B2B courier and logistics company, not a consumer gig-delivery marketplace or freight brokerage.

records.title: Gent Dispatch software priority
records.content: Later explicit founder direction made Gent Dispatch the first major software product; website, Command, driver app, and client portal do not outrank that decision without a newer explicit decision.

records.title: Broader logistics network
records.content: Expansion into additional industries, markets, logistics software, deeper automation, APIs, AI, and a broader logistics network remains exploratory future context.
